Rotation.RotationNotes:
Resto Druid PvP rotation. Talent build: 11/0/60 (Balance/Feral/Resto).
KEY TALENTS ASSUMED: Nature's Focus 5/5 (70% pushback resist on Healing Touch / Nourish / Regrowth / Tranquility -- vital), Nature's Swiftness, Tree of Life, Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Improved Barkskin, Nature's Grasp.
STRATEGY: heal yourself + ally through pressure, CC focus on the side. Heal Engine handles target selection for HoT/direct heals.
FOCUS SETUP: set /focus on the enemy healer or the DPS training you. - Cyclone (Focus) fires on any focus cast/channel (interrupts Poly, Fear, big heals), or on a healer over 95% HP as a setup peel. - Entangling Roots (Focus) fires on melee focus (Warr/Rogue/DK) not already CCed. - Faerie Fire keeps armor debuff + anti-stealth on Rogue/Druid targets.
DEFENSIVE AUTO: - Barkskin: HP < 65%, or on stun / silence table (uninterruptible casts under stun/silence); - NS + Healing Touch: HP < 35% -- Nature's Swiftness + instant max-rank HT on self, one-shot panic button (3 min CD, 2 min glyphed); - Nature's Grasp: proactive at HP < 80% for melee peel; - Innervate: existing threshold from B:Innervate.
MANUAL: - Left Ctrl pauses rotation; - do NOT target a friendly player (heal engine picks targets); - keep the enemy healer as /focus for Cyclone chains -- rotation DR-checks Cyclone against Entangling Roots on same focus.
